headline: Defence contracts to prioritise British jobs and skills
summary_en: Overseas firms winning UK defence contracts must invest benefits back into the UK under a new Offsets policy.
summary_zh: 赢得英国国防合同的海外公司须按新抵消政策回馈英国。
watch_en: Watch for how the new Offsets policy requires overseas defence firms to invest benefits back into the UK.
watch_zh: 关注新抵消政策如何要求海外国防公司回馈英国。
excerpt: Overseas firms winning UK defence contracts to be required to invest benefits back into the UK under new Offsets policy.
